menu_items.name: The Choco Loco Signature Bubble Waffle
menu_items.description: Golden bubble waffle drenched in warm Belgian milk chocolate, fresh ripe strawberries, Lotus Biscoff biscuit crunch, and artisanal vanilla gelato.

menu_items.name: Triple Chocolate Indulgence Waffle
menu_items.description: Layered with white chocolate drizzle, dark Belgian ganache, milk chocolate pearls, and chocolate fudge brownie chunks.

menu_items.name: Pistachio White Chocolate Sushi Crepe
menu_items.description: Delicately rolled chocolate crepe filled with rich cream, sliced into sushi maki pieces, drizzled with Sicilian pistachio butter and roasted pistachios.

menu_items.name: Fettuccine Chocolate Crepe
menu_items.description: Finely sliced crepe ribbons styled like pasta, bathed in melted Belgian chocolate fondue, served with fresh raspberry compote and vanilla gelato.

menu_items.name: Lotus Biscoff Crown Cheesecake
menu_items.description: Silky, dense Philadelphia cream cheese infused with speculoos, topped with warm Lotus spread glaze, whole Biscoff cookie, and spun caramel crown.

menu_items.name: Belgian Molten Lava Fondant
menu_items.description: Warm dark chocolate sponge bursting with an oozing liquid chocolate center, served with Madagascan vanilla ice cream and gold leaf flakes.

menu_items.name: Choco Loco Monster Freakshake
menu_items.description: Gigantic milkshake blended with Belgian chocolate gelato, topped with a brownie square, whipped cream mountain, chocolate pretzel, and chocolate drizzle.

menu_items.name: Iced Dulce de Leche Spanish Latte
menu_items.description: Double espresso pulled over condensed sweet milk, fresh whole milk, chilled over crystal ice, dusted with Ceylon cinnamon.

menu_items.name: Smoked Turkey & Truffle Melt Croissant
menu_items.description: All-butter flaky French croissant toasted with smoked turkey breast, melted Emmental cheese, baby arugula, and a gentle truffle aioli.
